models.label: SQL
models.availabilityReason: relational SQL over pgwire; the ORM capability report lists what the ORM can rely on (71/140 probes supported through pg)
models.transactionNote: DML commits and rolls back (savepoints included) and other sessions do not see uncommitted rows; DDL is NOT transactional (it survives ROLLBACK and is visible before COMMIT); isolation levels and READ ONLY are not applied (every level behaves as read committed)
models.durabilityNote: committed rows survived SIGKILL and restart in the X04 restart battery; power loss was not measured
warnings: DDL runs outside the transaction: a failed migration leaves earlier statements applied
BEGIN READ ONLY does not stop writes on this engine
no advisory locks, statement_timeout or query cancellation

models.label: Key-Value
models.availabilityReason: string/typed values, TTLs, namespaces and collections pass the X04 live battery
models.transactionNote: not measured on this build; the engine documents that ROLLBACK undoes scalar KV writes without isolating them from other sessions, and that collection (list/hash/set) writes are refused inside a transaction
models.durabilityNote: KV state survived SIGKILL and restart in the X04 restart battery; power loss was not measured
warnings: one global keyspace: namespaces are key prefixes, not permissions
other sessions can read uncommitted KV writes (engine semantics document)

models.label: Vector
models.availabilityReason: pgvector-style SQL columns are unsupported on this build (the ORM's vector capability resolves unsupported, 0A000); the Nucleus VECTOR_* function surface Studio browses is not measured
models.transactionNote: not measured on this build
models.durabilityNote: not measured on this build
warnings: vector results are not verified against an independent oracle on this engine

models.label: TimeSeries
models.availabilityReason: TS_* insert, count and range reads pass the X03 leg (range scoping checked against hand oracles)
models.transactionNote: not measured on this build
models.durabilityNote: points survived SIGKILL and restart in the X03 leg; power loss was not measured
warnings: retention policies are global and retroactive: they delete existing and backfilled points of every series

models.label: Document
models.availabilityReason: collection-scoped DOC_* functions resolve supported (value-asserting probes, X02)
models.transactionNote: ROLLBACK removes the transaction's documents and COMMIT publishes them, but other sessions read them before COMMIT; Studio and the client run each document call as its own statement
models.durabilityNote: committed documents survived SIGKILL and restart; an open transaction's documents were gone (X02 leg); power loss was not measured
warnings: no isolation: other sessions see uncommitted documents
collections are namespaces, not access control

models.label: Graph
models.availabilityReason: GRAPH_NODE/GRAPH_NEIGHBORS and property matching resolve supported (X02); traversal is bounded client-side
models.transactionNote: ROLLBACK removes the transaction's nodes and COMMIT publishes them, but other sessions read them before COMMIT
models.durabilityNote: committed nodes survived SIGKILL and restart (X02 leg); power loss was not measured
warnings: one global graph: no tenant, namespace or permission boundary
no isolation: other sessions see uncommitted nodes
GRAPH_QUERY takes Cypher text only (no parameters)

models.label: Full-Text
models.availabilityReason: PostgreSQL-style full-text functions are faked on this build (to_tsvector returns its argument, ts_rank is constant) and resolve unsupported; the FTS_* document index Studio browses is not measured
models.transactionNote: not measured on this build; the engine documents that FTS_* index writes happen at statement time and are only best-effort undone by ROLLBACK
models.durabilityNote: not measured on this build
warnings: FTS_* index writes are not tied to the SQL transaction (engine semantics document)

models.label: Geo
models.availabilityReason: GEO_* functions match hand oracles; layers are ordinary SQL tables (X04 live battery)
models.transactionNote: pure functions hold no state; layer rows are SQL rows with SQL's limits
models.durabilityNote: no geo store exists; layer rows are SQL rows

models.label: Blob
models.availabilityReason: byte-exact round trips, ranges and streaming pass the X04 live battery
models.transactionNote: not measured on this build
models.durabilityNote: blobs survived SIGKILL and restart in the X04 restart battery; power loss was not measured
warnings: blob writes are separate statements from any SQL row that references them

models.label: Streams
models.availabilityReason: STREAM_* append, range, consumer groups and acks pass the X05 leg
models.transactionNote: ROLLBACK removes a pending append (X05 leg); isolation from other sessions is not measured
models.durabilityNote: entries, groups, cursors and acks survived SIGKILL and restart (X05 leg); power loss was not measured
warnings: resume with the last entry's full id: a bare millisecond cursor silently skips entries in that millisecond
consumer-group delivery is at-most-once

models.label: Columnar
models.availabilityReason: COLUMNAR_* store and engine='columnar' tables pass the X03 leg
models.transactionNote: COLUMNAR_* store inserts are refused inside an explicit transaction and are append-only; engine='columnar' SQL tables honour ROLLBACK like SQL tables
models.durabilityNote: store rows survived SIGKILL and restart (X03 leg); power loss was not measured
warnings: COLUMNAR_* inserts cannot join a transaction
numbers passed as quoted text are stored as text and aggregate wrongly

models.label: Datalog
models.availabilityReason: DATALOG_* facts, rules and recursive queries pass the X05 leg
models.transactionNote: not measured on this build; the engine documents that a rolled-back DATALOG_ASSERT can return after a restart (its log is not compensated on rollback)
models.durabilityNote: facts and rules survived SIGKILL and restart (X05 leg); power loss was not measured
warnings: a rolled-back assertion can reappear after a restart (engine semantics document)

models.label: CDC
models.availabilityReason: CDC_READ / CDC_TABLE_READ pass the X05 leg (metadata-only events)
models.transactionNote: events are emitted at statement time, before COMMIT; a rolled-back transaction's events stay in the log with no compensating record
models.durabilityNote: the log replayed and its sequence continued after SIGKILL and restart (X05 leg); per-event fsync is not measured
warnings: only INSERT statements emit events on this build: UPDATE and DELETE never reach the log
events are metadata only (seq, table, change, ts) and include rolled-back work

models.label: PubSub
models.availabilityReason: LISTEN/NOTIFY cross-connection delivery and the PUBSUB_* publish surface pass the X05 leg, with divergences
models.transactionNote: notifications sent inside a rolled-back transaction are still delivered
models.durabilityNote: in-memory fan-out: nothing is persisted, and a message published with no subscriber is dropped (engine semantics document)
warnings: an idle listener receives nothing until it runs a statement
messages are lost on restart
